column1: # The lock of an item by an open pull request's head branch (incident-platform backlog #0-278 AC11, ADR-0060 D8 as
# amended): an item 0-N is held by a head branch that contains /0-N- (a slash, the item, a dash), and by no other.
# Both sides of the rule read this file: the dispatcher's lock (dispatcher/src/github/item-lock.mjs, its test
# .github/scripts/test-queue.sh, from a copy of this file). The copy is held equal to this one by incident-platform's
# check of the factory's copies (#0-268, ADR-0061): a change of the rule is made here and there in step.
# Format: lines starting with # are comments; every other line is one case, three fields separated by one tab:
# held: the branch holds the item; free: it does not.
